review.reviewer: Claude, maintainer-authorized source and dependency review (AF-CTR-04 delegated author, E1a); PR review is recorded separately
review.rationale: AF-CTR-04 part E1a (fleet schema, node credentials, keys, enrollment and the lock order), tested MOCKED (center/internal/nodetest drives the node side), with the fleet surface dark in production: the successor of the admission at cloud-release-r81. The Go sources of the center change: migration 0004 (the fleet schema, the node and published-key tables, the node session scope and their runtime grants), the fleet domain (Enroll under one savepoint in the global lock order, the node session refresh with strict rotation, the node report, sign-out, the published keys and key retirement), the fleet API on the Worker surface fleet, node-scoped admission in session and access, the node rate-limit buckets, the closed ObserveFleet metrics family, the admin commands revoke-device and retire-key, and the operator's revoke-sessions taking the account locks first. The Contracts Go module moves to v1.0.0-ci.424.1 (Contracts #125, a5bc52f) under go-contractsgo-legal-r3; its LICENSE and NOTICE are unchanged. The generated Worker tables gain the fleet surface and its routes, so the Worker bundle changes; .dockerignore keeps the test doubles of center/internal/nodetest out of the Docker context. The tests and the documents are not part of the image or the bundle. No other Go module, npm package, base image, toolchain or legal file changes. It supersedes the admission at cloud-release-r81.
